newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy plans topper turnaround Apr-May '97.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy plans topper turnaround Apr-May '97.

text.p: Refiner Japan Energy Corp said on Thursday it planned to close its 90,200 barrel-per-day (bpd) topper at the Mizushima refinery from early April to mid-May 1997 for maintenance checks.
Japan Energy's other crude distillation units are not scheduled to be closed for maintenance checks next year.
Another 110,000 bpd topper at the Mizushima refinery in southern Japan and a 95,000 bpd topper at the Chita refinery in central Japan were closed this year for maintenance work.
Most oil firms close their crude distillation units for turnarounds every other year.
